binding.mcp_shape: exclusive object, not array; no verify property

transport_limits: MCP hwp_read provides legacy markdown with_segments, not CLI segments v2 or JSON with segments.
MCP insert_para does not expose inline style/char; use a separate apply_style call after refreshing the inserted address.
MCP hwp_render does not expose report/layout_json; export those artifacts with CLI. MCP certify still publishes policy/render evidence.
A binding request is exclusive and cannot be combined with style edits, report or allow_partial.
Same-format binding only; convert first and rediscover if changing native input format.
evidence_limits: Owner-authored synthetic P0 variant only; no private or genuine raw-Hancom corpus is a reference input.
source_sha256 in an original_form plan is declared/echoed, not checked against a separately loaded source. Retain extraction and binding receipts.
Original-form certification checks expected values and table row/column dimensions, not a full source-to-output width/border/style/merge projection.

No person-run Hancom open/export, universal native-table PDF, portable golden pages, or pixel-parity evidence. The recorded reference_run artifacts have no Hancom evidence; hancom_open_export_receipts holds one agent-performed Hancom open/export receipt bound only to a separate rerun with released ahwp 2.0.0 and its own artifact hashes.
HWP retains one table_cell_content_overflow warning despite complete expected-text coverage and a passing selected policy; visual/native review remains separate.
This reference build was a pre-release main build that reported package version 1.4.0; version text alone does not establish feature availability. The workflow first ships in v1.5.0.
Self-contained JSON re-entry was compared semantically on this fixture, not asserted byte-identical to the original native file or universal opaque-record preservation.
